elimination_notes:
1. Flush front wall at v=0 (USB edge) — ELIMINATED. Plug overmold 11.5 mm wide vs receptacle bbox 9.449 mm (Δ +2.05): a wall slot hugging the connector cannot pass the overmold, and the plug body crosses the board-edge plane from mating face v=1.963 to v=−6.04 (6.04 mm outboard demand), plus pigtail to v=−28. Front must be a bay/pocket (P13-class: flush panel cutout killed by overmold-width probe).
2. Flush sidewalls at u-min/u-max — ELIMINATED. J3 pins end 1.69 mm from the edge, but the jumper wire arc reaches u=−4.5 at z≤10; a wall inner face at u=0 leaves a 4.5 mm deficit. Sidewalls standoff ≥4.5 mm outboard or full-height bays over v[3.0, 50.3] (mirror for J4 at u=57.84).
3. Flush lid at tallest measured solid (8.5) — ELIMINATED. Dupont service over J2/J3/J4 needs z≈14; lid at 8.5 interferes by 5.5 mm. Lid ≥14 over header strips or open-top carrier.
4. Board flipped (components down) — ELIMINATED. All five solids on one face; flip seats headers into the floor to 8.5 deep, puts the USB bay and jumper service through the floor (unserviceable). Orientation stage holds USB edge out at v=0, components up.
5. 90° rotation (USB exiting a u edge) — ELIMINATED. Receptacle center u=26.6755 would land mid-wall where both jumper corridors span v[3.0, 50.3]; a 12 mm front bay there merges into the side openings — one continuous 47 mm breach.
6. Corner bosses instead of measured holes — ELIMINATED. ⌀6 boss at (3,3) spans u[0,6]×v[0,6]; J3 occupies u[1.69,5.93]×v[4.23,…] ⇒ 1.77 mm interference band (v[4.23, 6.0]). Bosses at the measured holes clear everything by ≥3.77 mm — keep them.
reasoning:
Inputs cover 5 solids, 4 holes, no antenna rule areas, no battery (S3 gate: every connector + antenna + battery + removal path must be covered — antenna/battery explicitly "none in extraction"). Connectors split by service class: J1 is an edge-mating connector (plug travels through the v=0 board plane), J2/J3/J4 are top-plugged headers (Dupont jumper bodies + wire arcs are NOT on the PCB — the only legal hand-typed class). U1 is sealed-on, keep-out only.
Anchor numbers from the extraction: board 53.34×53.34×1.6; holes ⌀2.7 at u∈{12.7, 40.64}, v∈{5.457, 47.883} — symmetric (12.70 mm from each u edge, 5.457 mm from each v edge). J1 receptacle center u=26.6755, mating face at v=1.963 (i.e., 1.963 mm inboard of the edge plane the plug must cross). Header spans: J3 u[1.69,5.93], J4 mirror u[47.41,51.65], both v[4.23,49.11], h8.5. Boss fit probe at ⌀6.0 outer: clearance to J3 = (12.7−3.0) − 5.93 = 3.77 mm, identical 3.77 mm to J4, 6.25 mm to J1, 5.64 mm to U1 — bosses at the measured holes pass; corner bosses do not (see elimination). Tallest measured solid = 8.5 (headers), but Dupont service over headers demands ~14 z, which sets the real lid height, not 8.5. Mating sweep: USB plug occupies v from the mating face 1.963 outward ~8 mm (v=−6.04), pigtail loop ⌀~25 extends the corridor to v=−28. No second geometry source exists (KiCad only) — hole ⌀2.7 is single-source, flagged for S4.
